seed.rtmNotes:
Harbor & Pine is a made-up creator brand for the demo.
Audience: people starting a small channel or a small business account with a phone and very little gear.
Voice: first person, plain and warm, one practical tip at a time.
Never promise growth numbers.
seed.whosWho: Mira: the made-up host of Harbor & Pine (the presenter stand-in in the demo videos).

brandNotes.crumb:
Made-up neighborhood bakery.
Sells: sourdough (40 loaves on Saturdays), weekend boxes, birthday cakes, Sunday baking classes.
Voice: warm and specific, food first.
Never say: cheapest.
brandNotes.ironleaf:
Made-up small group fitness studio.
Sells: a free first class, coached small group classes, the Six Week Reset.
Voice: encouraging, never shaming.
Claims not allowed: weight loss numbers.
brandNotes.spoke:
Made-up bike shop.
Sells: bikes, spring tune ups (48 hours or free), flat fixes, kids bike fitting.
Voice: friendly and practical.
